title: Science Secondary Model Upgrades — Geometry, Cosmography and Human Map
purpose: Record targeted improvements to promising models outside the primary Wave 012 workstreams. These upgrades add uncertainty, identifiability and robustness tests rather than new grand theory layers.

records.improvement: Adds center-sensitivity mathematics, nuisance-parameter profiling, parametric bootstrap calibration, leave-arc-out validation and an explicit underidentification downgrade state.
records.value: Prevents a visually chosen center from manufacturing agreement with the golden growth constant.

records.improvement: Propagates quoted uncertainty into the archive-derived anisotropy statistic and separates velocity anisotropy from boundary geometry and topology.
records.value: Turns a central-value observation into an uncertainty-aware model component and blocks the inference that anisotropic flow alone proves potato-like geometry.

records.improvement: Adds latent-state identifiability, parameter recovery, reliability, state/trait factorization, measurement invariance and incremental-validity gates.
records.value: Prevents arbitrary latent factors or unstable hidden-state labels from being promoted to canonical consciousness states.

shared_principle: A model becomes more serious when uncertainty, nuisance choices and latent ambiguity are made explicit enough that the model can be downgraded or rejected.
relationship_to_wave_012: These records are side improvements, not substitutes for the approved Wave 012 gravity, UPT/Higgs and Handshake workstreams.
